description: This file defines the ScreenCache class, which manages caching of widget outputs associated with screen names and cache keys within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ScreenCache
classes.description: A cache management class for storing and retrieving widget outputs associated with screen names.

methods.name: ScreenCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with the type 'screen'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the cached widget output for a given screen name and cache key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a widget output in the cache for a specific screen name and cache key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the widget output associated with a screen name and cache key, with verbose debug logging.
